stalls.zh: 堂薯薯臭薯條（羅東總店）
stalls.en: Tang Shu Shu Stinky Tofu Fries
foods: 臭豆腐薯條（起司、泰式酸辣等口味）
stalls.summaryZh: 把臭豆腐切成薯條狀油炸，外酥內軟、方便邊走邊吃，起司與泰式酸辣醬最常被推薦；冷掉也有人說好吃。
stalls.summaryEn: Stinky tofu cut into fries and deep-fried: crisp outside, soft inside, easy to eat on the go. Cheese and Thai sweet-sour sauces are favorites, and some say it's good even cold.

stalls.summaryZh: 羅東夜市代表性的羊肉湯，湯頭偏甜、肉質嫩、價格親民，但排隊很長。
stalls.summaryEn: One of the market's signature lamb soups: slightly sweet broth, tender meat and fair prices, but expect a long line.

stalls.summaryZh: 招牌是把臭豆腐和肉末包進起司酥皮的臭豆腐堡，帶奶香很特別；每日限量容易賣完，位置不在主要動線上。
stalls.summaryEn: Known for a stinky tofu 'burger' wrapped in cheese pastry with minced pork, with a milky aroma. Limited daily and sells out fast; slightly off the main strip.

stalls.summaryZh: 餅皮薄、三星蔥餡塞得很滿，半煎炸到酥脆，咬下有湯汁要小心燙，是蔥控排隊名單常客。
stalls.summaryEn: Thin crust packed with Sanxing scallions, pan-fried until crisp; the juicy filling is hot, so take care. A regular on scallion lovers' lists.
